title: ImpactReport
description: Which of an upgrade edge's changes matter to ONE environment, produced by joining an UpgradeEdge with locally parsed environment inputs (values files, manifests, installed CRDs, image references, a cluster version). Every finding cites two provenance chains: upstream evidence copied from the edge and environment evidence pointing at the user's files. Deterministic only; referential integrity (both chains resolve within this document) is checked by domain.ImpactReport.Validate() in Go and cannot be expressed in JSON Schema.

AIProvenance.description: Provenance of AI output: method is "ai" and model, modelVersion, promptVersion, promptDigest, inputEvidence (at least one evidence id) and generatedAt are required, so every enrichment can be traced to the model that answered, the exact prompt and the evidence it was given.

DeterministicProvenance.description: Provenance of deterministic knowledge: method is declared, computed or heuristic, and the AI-only fields (model, modelVersion, promptVersion, promptDigest, inputEvidence, generatedAt) must be absent. A Change can never be method "ai".

Evidence.description: A verifiable pointer to source material supporting a fact or conclusion. `uri` is something a human can open; `locator` narrows it down; `excerpt` and `contentDigest` pin what was read.

sourceId.description: Id of the product-definition source or artifact that produced the evidence.

uri.description: Location a human or a later run can open to check the claim.

locator.description: Position within the document, e.g. a line range ("L120-L131"), a heading ("## Breaking Changes") or a JSONPath ("$.spec.versions[1]").

excerpt.description: Short verbatim excerpt of the source, truncated.

contentDigest.description: sha256 of the complete retrieved document, so the exact bytes the conclusion was drawn from can be identified later.

representation.description: Which published form of the artifact these bytes came from: source-tree (a file in the source repository), published-chart-tgz (a chart tarball from a chart repository), published-oci-chart (a chart pulled as an OCI artifact), release-asset (a file attached to a release), http-document (a plain HTTP document) or registry-manifest (an OCI manifest/config). Orthogonal to Provenance.method, which states how knowledge was derived, not from which bytes.

EvidenceID.description: Stable identifier derived from the evidence content ("ev-" followed by a short hash).

ImpactCheck.description: One entry of an evaluation record: what was checked against what, so a not-affected verdict is auditable without re-running anything.

dimension.description: The environment input class consulted: values, manifests, crds, images, or cluster-version (platform names it).

platform.description: Cluster platform of a cluster-version check ("kubernetes", "openshift", ...).

facts.description: How many environment facts of that dimension were compared (0 when the input was supplied but yielded none).

subjects.description: The upstream subjects compared against those facts.

evidence.description: Environment evidence proving a directly-supplied input (the --kubernetes / --images flag); file-backed dimensions are audited through environment.files digests.

ImpactEnvironment.description: Summary of the environment inputs the join consumed.

kubernetes.description: Cluster Kubernetes version as supplied (e.g. "1.31" or "1.31.5").

ImpactFile.description: One environment input file with the digest of the bytes that were parsed.

path.description: Path exactly as supplied on the command line (evidence URIs use the same form).

ImpactFinding.description: One deterministic verdict of the applicability engine: an upstream change (or compatibility constraint, or moved image artifact) met the environment — or could not be evaluated. Affected classes (action-required / review-required / informational) cite both evidence chains; not-affected carries the evaluation record (`checks`); unknown carries `neededToDetermine`. See docs/ACTION_CLASSIFICATION.md.

classification.description: What to do (docs/ACTION_CLASSIFICATION.md): action-required — the environment must change to avoid concrete failure, evidenced on both chains, high confidence only; review-required — credible overlap, applicability not deterministically provable; informational — evidenced overlap with no action implied; not-affected — checked against a supplied environment dimension and clear; unknown — applicability undeterminable, `neededToDetermine` says why.

severity.description: How bad if it bites (independent axis): critical (upgrade fails outright), high (concrete degradation), medium (needs a look), low (confirmed no-action overlap). Absent for not-affected/unknown.

rule.description: Join rule that fired, e.g. "impact:values-removed"; verdict records use impact:values-unset / impact:not-joined / impact:insufficient-visibility / ... .

detail.description: Prose explaining the verdict: what upstream changed and which environment fact matched — or what could not be checked, and why.

changeId.description: Id of the upstream Change in the UpgradeEdge this report was built from; absent when the finding comes from a compatibility constraint or artifact move alone.

changeTitle.description: Copy of the upstream change's title, so the report renders standalone.

changeCategory.description: Copy of the upstream change's category.

changeBreaking.description: Copy of the upstream change's breaking flag.

matches.description: The environment facts that made the finding fire, each with its own environment evidence (affected classes only).

upstreamEvidence.description: Chain 1: Evidence ids resolving in `evidence` (every class).

environmentEvidence.description: Chain 2: Evidence ids resolving in `environmentEvidence` (affected classes; check evidence for verdict records).

checks.description: Evaluation record of a not-affected verdict (and the partial record of an unknown one): which environment dimension was consulted, how many facts were compared, which upstream subjects were compared.

neededToDetermine.description: What evidence was missing for an unknown verdict, e.g. "Helm values files (--values) not supplied"; unknown-only by contract.

ImpactMatch.description: One environment fact that matched: what it is (subject) and the local evidence that proves the environment has it.

kind.description: What kind of environment fact: a set values key, an apiVersion in use, an installed CRD or one of its versions, a manifest field path, an image in use, or the cluster Kubernetes version.

subject.description: The fact itself: a values key path, "group/version Kind", a CRD name, a field path, an image reference or a version string.

evidence.description: Environment evidence ids backing this match.

ImpactReport.description: Which of an upgrade edge's changes matter to ONE environment, produced by joining an UpgradeEdge with locally parsed environment inputs (values files, manifests, installed CRDs, image references, a cluster version). Every finding cites two provenance chains: upstream evidence copied from the edge and environment evidence pointing at the user's files. Deterministic only; referential integrity (both chains resolve within this document) is checked by domain.ImpactReport.Validate() in Go and cannot be expressed in JSON Schema.

environment.description: What the join ran against: the supplied cluster version, the parsed input files with digests, counts of extracted facts and parsing warnings.

summary.description: The funnel: all upstream changes, those with affected findings, and the explicit count of every verdict class — unknowns are counted, never folded into not-affected.

findings.description: One verdict per analyzed unit: affected overlaps first (action-required, review-required, informational), then unknown, then the not-affected evaluation records.

evidence.description: Chain 1: upstream Evidence records cited by findings, copied from the UpgradeEdge the report was built from.

environmentEvidence.description: Chain 2: Evidence records of kind local-file / input pointing at the user's environment inputs.

definitionDigest.description: Digest of the product definition revision the underlying edge was built from.

ImpactSummary.description: Counts of the impact funnel; must equal the findings (checked by Validate). Unknowns are counted explicitly, never folded into not-affected.

Provenance.description: How a Change, note classification, compatibility constraint or Enrichment was produced. This is the generic shape; documents use DeterministicProvenance where only deterministic methods are allowed (Change.provenance, NoteItem.classification, CompatibilityConstraint.provenance) and AIProvenance for Enrichment.provenance.

method.description: How the knowledge was derived. declared: upstream stated it explicitly in a structured or labelled way (an item under a "Breaking Changes" heading, a release-note YAML with "action required", a published support matrix). computed: deterministic computation over source data (a diff of two values.yaml files or two CRD sets). heuristic: deterministic but pattern-based interpretation (keyword matching such as "deprecated" inside a bug-fix bullet); treat with more caution than declared or computed. ai: produced by a language model; only valid on Enrichments.

producer.description: Component and version that produced the record, e.g. "normalize.notes@v1".

rule.description: Identifier of the rule that fired, e.g. "section:/breaking/i".

model.description: AI only: identifier of the model that answered, as reported by the API response or the exchange response file (never assumed from the request).

modelVersion.description: AI only: the most precise version identifier of that model reported with the answer (a pinned snapshot id when the provider reports no separate version).

promptVersion.description: AI only: version of the prompt templates, e.g. "enrich/v1"; promptDigest pins the exact rendered prompt.

promptDigest.description: AI only: digest of the exact prompt, so the generation can be reproduced or audited.

inputEvidence.description: AI only: ids of the Evidence records the model was given as input.

generatedAt.description: AI only: when the output was generated.

Representation.description: Which published form of an artifact a fact came from. The same content (chart defaults, CRDs, metadata) can exist in the source tree and in several artifacts users actually consume, and publishers rewrite content at packaging time; the representation keeps the two apart. Orthogonal to Provenance.method (how knowledge was derived).

Version.description: A release version of a product.

tag.description: Identifier exactly as published by the canonical release channel, e.g. "v1.18.0".

version.description: Normalised semantic version without any tag prefix, e.g. "1.18.0".
